seats.school: School of Liberal Arts (College of Arts, Social Sciences and Humanities)

records.name: Arwin D. Smallwood
records.priorTitle: Professor and Chair, Department of History and Political Science
records.priorInstitution: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University
records.notes: Appointed dean effective June 1, 2024; also previously served as interim vice provost for undergraduate education at NC A&T.

records.name: Shauntae White
records.priorTitle: Unknown (interim appointment)
records.notes: Served as interim dean of the College of Arts, Social Sciences and Humanities preceding Smallwood's 2024 appointment; exact start date not confirmed in sources reviewed.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts and Sciences

records.name: Robert Brinkmann
records.priorTitle: Dean of Graduate Studies and Vice Provost for Research
records.notes: Began as dean July 1, 2020; still dean as of 2024-2025 NIU materials.

records.name: Christopher McCord
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (also served as Acting Executive Vice President & Provost)
records.notes: Predecessor to Brinkmann; later became Senior Advisor, Division of Administration and Finance (2019-2021) and subsequently Associate Dean for Academic Administration at CLAS. Exact start year of his deanship not confirmed.

records.name: Francene J. Lemoine
records.priorTitle: Interim Dean, College of Arts and Sciences
records.notes: Served as interim dean for the 2019-20 academic year after Handel's promotion, then named permanent dean in December 2020.

records.name: Greg Handel
records.priorTitle: Director, School of Creative and Performing Arts
records.notes: Interim dean starting July 2016; named permanent dean in 2017. Promoted to Provost/VP for Academic Affairs in May 2019, prompting Lemoine's interim appointment.

seats.school: College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (now part of Halmos College of Arts and Sciences)

records.name: Robin Cooper
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Current dean of Halmos College of Arts and Sciences (the successor entity after CAHSS merged with the Halmos College of Natural Sciences and Oceanography in 2020). Exact appointment year not confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Holly Baumgartner
records.priorTitle: Interim Provost
records.notes: Named Dean of Halmos College of Arts and Sciences and the Guy Harvey Oceanographic Research Center, effective September 6, 2021, following the 2020 merger of CAHSS with Halmos College of Natural Sciences and Oceanography. End year of her tenure not confirmed.

records.name: Honggang Yang
records.priorTitle: Faculty, graduate program in conflict resolution
records.notes: Served as dean of the Graduate School of Humanities and Social Sciences and the College of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences (CAHSS) from 1999-2020, prior to the college's 2020 merger into Halmos College of Arts and Sciences.

records.name: Bradley J. Swanson
records.priorTitle: Interim Vice President for Research and Innovation and Professor of Biology
records.notes: Appointed dean effective August 1, 2026, pending Board of Trustees approval; Joseph Shively (senior associate dean) served as acting dean July 2-31, 2026 during the transition.

records.name: Elaine K. Carey
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Named dean effective June 30, 2021; prior title/institution not confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Kevin J. Corcoran
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Served as dean July 2013-July 2021 (postponed a planned 2019 retirement); now Dean Emeritus, College of Arts and Sciences.

records.name: Laura Delbrugge
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Arts and Sciences (also Dean, College of Arts and Humanities for the integrated PASSHE universities)
records.notes: Named dean effective July 9, 2022 following a national search.

records.name: Jonathan Leib
records.priorTitle: Professor and Chair, Department of Political Science and Geography
records.notes: Named interim dean effective January 25, 2021, succeeding Kent Sandstrom; served until Delbrugge's 2022 permanent appointment.

records.name: Kent Sandstrom
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Stepped down as dean in early 2021 to return to full-time teaching in the Department of Sociology and Criminal Justice; start year of his deanship not confirmed.

records.name: Leroy E. Bynum, Jr.
records.priorTitle: Dean, School of Arts and Humanities
records.priorInstitution: The College of Saint Rose (Albany, NY)
records.notes: Began as dean in August 2017; previously dean at The College of Saint Rose (2014-2017) and, before that, a professor of voice and opera for 22 years at Albany State University in Georgia. Name of his PSU predecessor not confirmed.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (School of Arts and Humanities)

records.name: Simone L. Yearwood
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean and Chief Librarian, Benjamin S. Rosenthal Library
records.notes: Named interim dean in July 2023 after William McClure's departure; appointed permanent dean in March 2026 following a national search.

records.name: William McClure
records.priorTitle: Acting Dean of Faculty, Division of Arts and Humanities
records.notes: Won the permanent Dean of Faculty, Arts and Humanities position in 2013 (reported in Queens College Magazine, Fall 2013) after serving as acting dean; also led founding of the Queens College School of Arts in 2021. Departed in July 2023.

seats.school: College of Liberal Arts (now Ric Edelman College of Communication, Humanities & Social Sciences)

records.name: Nawal Ammar
records.priorTitle: Dean, College of Humanities and Social Sciences
records.notes: Named founding dean (Aug. 2025) of the newly merged Ric Edelman College of Communication, Humanities & Social Sciences, formed by combining the College of Humanities and Social Sciences (which she led) with the former Ric Edelman College of Communication & Creative Arts.

records.name: Nawal Ammar
records.priorTitle: Dean, Faculty of Social Science and Humanities
records.priorInstitution: University of Ontario Institute of Technology
records.notes: Served as dean of Rowan's College of Humanities and Social Sciences starting August 2016, after 9 years as dean at the University of Ontario Institute of Technology, before the 2025 merger created the current college.

records.name: Sanford Tweedie
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Led the former Ric Edelman College of Communication & Creative Arts (the college's other merger partner) since 2016, prior to the 2025 reorganization.

seats.school: College of Liberal and Creative Arts

records.name: David Landy
records.priorTitle: Professor and Chair, Department of Philosophy
records.notes: Became interim dean of the College of Liberal & Creative Arts beginning July 2026; had taught at SF State since 2009. Name of predecessor dean not confirmed in sources reviewed.

seats.school: College of Humanities and the Arts

records.name: Shannon Miller
records.priorTitle: Chair, Department of English and Comparative Literature
records.notes: Accepted the dean position effective December 1, 2017; had been at SJSU since 2014 and previously chaired the English department at Temple University for 6 years. Predecessor's name not confirmed in sources reviewed.

seats.university: Savannah College of Art and Design

records.name: Dale Clifford
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean of Building Arts, Fine Arts and Foundation Studies
records.priorInstitution: Savannah College of Art and Design
records.notes: Currently Dean of academics for the School of Fine Arts, School of Visual Communication (Atlanta and Savannah), and School of Foundation Studies (Atlanta). Was associate dean 2014-2015, then Dean of Academics 2015-2024, with School of Fine Arts specifically noted 2024-present in some records; exact title-change dates and predecessor unconfirmed.

records.name: Sabita Manian
records.priorTitle: Unknown
records.notes: Also holds title of Professor of Political Science; joined Shippensburg as dean of the College of Arts & Sciences (and Engineering) around July 2022. Prior title/institution and predecessor not confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Richard Deeg
records.priorTitle: Professor of Political Science
records.notes: Named dean in September 2016 after more than 25 years at Temple as a professor and scholar. His position became an endowed deanship ("The Christopher M. Barnett Dean for the College of Liberal Arts") in November 2025 following a gift from alumnus Christopher M. Barnett. Predecessor not confirmed in sources reviewed.

records.name: Scott Gronert
records.priorTitle: Associate Dean for Research, College of Humanities and Sciences
records.notes: Appointment announced November 15, 2018; still dean as of 2024 records reviewed.

records.name: G. Richard Meadows
records.priorTitle: Professor of Economics / Chair, Economics Department
records.notes: Predecessor dean, now Dean Emeritus, College of Letters and Science; exact years of service not confirmed in sources reviewed.
